sections.heading: Description
sections.content: Develop individual and team capacity within an organization to manage change as Sponsor or Leaders and Advocates. Enable them to energize groups that will be impacted by change and manage change initiatives smoothly by anticipating, preparing and responding effectively to obstacles. Leading change requires strong role models who demonstrate specific and consistent behavior. Senior leaders must carry out the activities of sponsorship to drive transformation success.

sections.heading: Business Value
sections.content: Strengthens leadership support for transformation. Enhances change credibility and momentum. Improves stakeholder confidence and engagement. Supports cultural and behavioral change. Enables effective governance and decision-making.
